note.question: Can a contest designer use entry fees and negative prizes to maximize both the winner's effort and total participation effort?
note.overview: Privately informed contestants choose entry and effort in a modified all-pay contest, while a designer chooses entry fee, reserve, and shared prize to maximize total or winner effort.

components.label: Symmetric Bayesian all-pay contest equilibrium with endogenous entry
components.explanation: The model's equilibrium concept is Symmetric Bayesian all-pay contest equilibrium with endogenous entry. Proposition 2, printed p. 5 (PDF p. 5), shows that the optimal contests induce full participation: types below the threshold enter with zero effort and zero expected prize, while higher types exert increasing effort. Proposition 1, printed/PDF p. 4, gives the optimal design.

components.label: Model sequence and system structure
components.explanation: The designer commits to an entry fee, effort reserve, and shared prize. Contestants privately observe ability and simultaneously choose whether to enter and, if entering, how much effort to exert. Prizes depend on whether the highest effort meets the reserve. Entry fees top up the winner's prize.
